scope.calibration_monotonicity_guard: a calibrator that is not non-decreasing would invert the direction decision, so isotonic monotonicity is verified on a grid and a Platt fit with non-positive slope is rejected and scored raw
scope.direction_decision: the model outputs p(primary side wins); it picks the primary side when p >= 0.5 and the opposite side otherwise, with confidence max(p, 1 - p) priced at that side's T-5 odds and settled with exact Asian handicap/total rules
scope.holdout_usage: final scoring only; never used for training, calibration or feature statistics
scope.kind: V3.1 genuine retraining with independent direction choice and probability calibration
scope.median_impute_source: discovery split medians plus explicit missingness flags
scope.roi_definition: one unit per bet when the chosen-direction confidence >= 0.55, priced at the chosen side's T-5 decimal odds; Asian half win/loss and push settled exactly
scope.target_definition: one row per fixture and market with a FIXED primary side: HDC home side, HIL over side. Label 1 for a full win, 0.5 for a half win, 0 for a half or full loss on that primary side; pushes are excluded from calibration metrics and from training. Both T-5 sides are read from the candidate list; the V2 maximum-EV lead is never the target.
scope.v2_baseline_definition: persisted production V2 probability of the same primary side (complement of the opposite side when only that side was published), scored against the same primary-side label; the production maximum-EV lead decision is reported separately under v2_baseline.<market>.production_lead_decision

split.method: chronological kickoff cohorts nearest to 60/20/20; equal kickoff is indivisible
